gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies omitted lateral boundary control for network fluxes. Gold I001 instead bundles unjustified Gauss–Green/traces for arbitrary measurable K∩Omega_s with a separate failure to obtain h-uniform control of the L1 gradient norm; neither gold defect is fully diagnosed.

ISSUE-002 concerns missing coupling estimates in a compound shock–rarefaction construction. Gold I003 concerns misclassification of strip-only cells and the resulting invalid smooth-interpolation estimate; the prediction does not recognize that cell class or its mesh-skeleton bound.

ISSUE-004 challenges exact representability of a multiplicative tanh surrogate in the network architecture. Gold I004 concerns whether solution-adapted comparison tests satisfy the admissibility constraint V_h^c; the prediction does not identify the missing amplitude bound or admissibility verification.

ISSUE-004 concerns failure of the tanh architecture to realize the proposed competitor. Gold I005 concerns the entropy-loss supremum lacking a zero baseline, so total loss need not dominate its components; no prediction recognizes that sign/nonnegativity obligation.

Both identify the omitted lateral-boundary flux produced by cellwise integration by parts, explain that compact support of the exact solution does not force the network minimizer to vanish there, and conclude that the claimed cancellation is unsupported.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The stability identity retains an uncontrolled lateral spatial-boundary flux because the network class and loss impose no corresponding boundary trace condition or penalty.

component_coverage.gold_component: Cellwise integration by parts produces a lateral-boundary network-flux term that is omitted from the cancellation identity and is uncontrolled by the stated loss.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies the lateral boundary terms, explains why support of the exact solution does not control the minimizer, and states that the claimed cancellation is unsupported.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 alleges omitted estimates for coupling between a shifted shock and rarefaction fan in a compound-wave proof. Gold I007 concerns multiple shock branches in one multidimensional cell and failure to construct compatible continuous CPwL traces; the prediction does not diagnose this geometric construction failure.
